<function name="RemoveKey" parent="CUserCmd" type="classfunc">
	<description>Removes a key bit from the current key bitflag.

For movement you will want to use <page>CUserCmd:SetForwardMove</page>, <page>CUserCmd:SetUpMove</page> and <page>CUserCmd:SetSideMove</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="button" type="number">Bitflag to be removed from the key bitflag, see <page>Enums/IN</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
